name: Flame
description: A flame trap that activates according to its type and configured conditions.

0.name: Jet of Fire
0.description: A standard jet of fire that can be toggled on and off using the Trigger Variable.

1.name: Jet of Fire (Off)
1.description: An initially inactive jet of fire that can be toggled on and off using the Trigger Variable.

2.name: Jet of Fire (When Approaching)
2.description: A jet of fire that can be toggled on and off using the Trigger Variable and reacts to approaching players.

3.name: Jet of Fire (Time-Based)
3.description: A jet of fire that operates on a timer and can be permanently extinguished.

4.name: Small Ring of Fire
4.description: An initially inactive small ring of fire that can be toggled on and off using the Trigger Variable.

5.name: Ring of Fire
5.description: An initially inactive ring of fire that can be toggled on and off using the Trigger Variable.

6.name: Jet of Fire (Extinguish When Disabled)
6.description: A jet of fire that can be permanently extinguished.

7.name: Jet of Fire (Inactive)
7.description: An inactive jet of fire that cannot be toggled using the Trigger Variable.

fields.name: Invisible Switch
fields.description: An invisible switch that sets a room flag. Its exact purpose is unknown.

fields.name: Direction
fields.description: Selects directional offsets and related orientation data.

fields.name: Flame Size Option
fields.description: Affects the flame's size or range through a floating-point calculation. The exact values are not yet confirmed.

fields.name: Trigger Variable
fields.description: The room-local variable used to trigger or activate the flame.
